attchmntText: TTK Healthcare Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors at its meeting held on November 20, 2026, have considered and approved the Scheme of Arrangement relating to the issuance of 5 Non-Convertible Redeemable Preference Shares (NCRPS) of Rs.100/- each fully paid up by way of bonus for every 1 equity share of Rs.10/- each fully paid up held as on the Record Date (as defined under the Scheme).
voiceSummary: TTK Healthcare Limited board approved a scheme to issue 7,06,51,665 Non-Convertible Redeemable Preference Shares by way of bonus. The ratio is five preference shares of Rs.100 each for every one equity share of Rs.10 held on the record date. The total issue size is Rs.706.52 crores. The preference shares carry a dividend rate of 9.5% per annum. The tenure is 15 months from the date of allotment. Redemption is at par, either at maturity or earlier at the board's option. Listing is proposed on BSE and NSE. The scheme is subject to approvals from shareholders, creditors, the NCLT, and stock exchanges. The announcement was made on November 20, 2026.

attchmntText: TTK Healthcare Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Trading Window closure pursuant to SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015
voiceSummary: TTK Healthcare Limited announces that its Board of Directors meeting is scheduled for November 20, 2026. The agenda includes considering and approving a Scheme of Arrangement under Section 230 of the Companies Act, 2013. This scheme involves the issuance of Non-Convertible Redeemable Preference Shares by way of Bonus to Equity Shareholders. The resolution is placed for Board approval. Additionally, the trading window for designated persons and their immediate relatives is closed from November 16, 2026, to November 22, 2026. This closure complies with the SEBI Prohibition of Insider Trading Regulations, 2015. Trading is prohibited during this period.
